name: second-draft.assignments.list
description: List the student's assignments, optionally for one course ID from policies.get: prompt, due date (with its local weekday), rubric criteria, latest draft version, submissions and grade. Reads change nothing; every read returns the current virtual time as as_of. An unknown course returns not_found.

name: second-draft.policies.get
description: Each course's AI-use policy: which assistant actions are allowed now (plan, reply, ask_instructor, suggest_language, suggest_content, edit) and the policy's change history. Second Draft does not enforce the policy. An unknown course returns not_found.

name: second-draft.drafts.list
description: The versions of the draft for one assignment (an assignment ID from assignments.list), oldest first, with who saved each. Versions never change. Unknown assignment: not_found.

name: second-draft.drafts.get
description: One version of an assignment's draft, as draft (the latest if version_id is omitted, null if there is none): each paragraph's text, the author of each sentence (student, agent for a direct edit, or suggestion for an accepted suggestion) and the authorship share in percent of characters; plus the suggestions on this draft with their status (pending, stale, accepted, rejected). Unknown assignment or version: not_found.

name: second-draft.drafts.diff
description: Compare two versions of one assignment's draft (version IDs from drafts.list): each paragraph is unchanged, changed, added or removed, with its text in both versions. Unknown IDs: not_found.

name: second-draft.comments.list
description: Comments on one assignment (an assignment ID from assignments.list) from the instructor, peers and the writing centre, each anchored to a version, a paragraph and the quoted words, with status (open, addressed, resolved) and replies; optionally only one status. Unknown assignment: not_found.

name: second-draft.checklist.get
description: The saved revision checklist for one assignment (an assignment ID from assignments.list), or null if none. Unknown assignment: not_found.

name: second-draft.messages.list
description: Messages in the course threads with instructors, optionally for one course ID from policies.get, oldest first. Unknown course: not_found.

name: second-draft.preferences.get
description: The student's own rules for their assistant (the actions they allow, which may include submit, and a note in their words) and their time zone. Second Draft does not enforce these rules.

name: second-draft.checklist.save
description: Save the revision checklist for one assignment (an assignment ID from assignments.list), replacing any earlier one: ordered items, each citing comment IDs (from comments.list) and rubric criterion IDs (from assignments.list) of that assignment. Refused: unknown assignment (not_found) or a comment or criterion of another assignment (unknown_reference).

name: second-draft.comments.reply
description: Reply to a comment (an ID from comments.list) on the student's behalf. Unknown comment: not_found.

name: second-draft.comments.set_status
description: Mark a comment addressed, or open again. Resolved comments are the commenter's to reopen (invalid_state); setting the status it already has is refused (invalid_state). Unknown comment: not_found.

name: second-draft.suggestions.create
description: Suggest a replacement for words quoted exactly from one paragraph of the latest version (paragraph IDs from drafts.get). It changes the draft only if the student accepts it, and becomes stale if the quote no longer appears exactly once. Second Draft classifies it under second-draft-edit-kind/1: A change is language when exactly one sentence changes, no sentence is added or removed, and at most 30% of that sentence's words change; anything else is content (splitting a sentence in two is content, a semicolon is not). Refused: unknown assignment or paragraph (not_found), no draft yet (invalid_state), a quote that does not appear exactly once (invalid_quote), or a replacement that changes nothing (invalid_arguments).

name: second-draft.drafts.edit
description: Replace the text of one paragraph of the latest version directly, creating a new version; new or altered sentences are authored by the agent. Second Draft classifies the edit under second-draft-edit-kind/1: A change is language when exactly one sentence changes, no sentence is added or removed, and at most 30% of that sentence's words change; anything else is content (splitting a sentence in two is content, a semicolon is not). Refused: unknown assignment or paragraph (not_found), no draft yet (invalid_state) or unchanged text (invalid_arguments).

name: second-draft.messages.send
description: Send a message to the instructor in a course thread (a course ID from policies.get), optionally replying to a message ID from messages.list. Unknown course or message: not_found.

name: second-draft.submissions.submit
description: Submit an existing version of an assignment's draft (a version ID from drafts.list) for grading. Versions never change, so a later resubmission names a newer version. Unknown assignment or version: not_found.
